name: setup-manaflow-ai-folio-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces, after the way team wikis and docs editors read: theme files for color and proportions (Folio, light, the default; Folio Dark), settings for a 16 px page of reading type, a page-width chat column and a sidebar that lists workspaces as a tree of pages, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for a gray prompt bubble, quiet secondary ink and slash-menu menus, and a customize view for a page-preview hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Folio sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Folio's hover card and sidebar rows: a page preview (the title as a heading, an edited line, the page's text, then its properties) and page rows in regular weight with a quiet dot while work runs, and the chat's page properties (agent, folder, branch) in Session Info.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" },
    "cmux.session.info.section/1": {
      "export": "renderPageProperties",
      "title": "Page properties",
      "symbol": "list.bullet.rectangle",
      "options": { "maxRows": 4 }
    }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": [
    "onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1",
    "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1",
    "onInterface:cmux.session.info.section/1"
  ],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
